info.title: Paynet E-commerce API
info.description:
Server-to-server API for Paynet e-commerce payments (Moldova): create orders, redirect the customer to the Paynet payment page, check payment status, refund, unlink saved cards and download statements.

Authentication: call POST /auth, then send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`.
Amounts are integers in minor units (100 = 1.00 MDL). Currency is ISO 4217 numeric (498 = MDL).
One shop order = one `Order`: repeating it with the same data returns the same payment; with different data or after payment it fails with 500 TECHNICAL_ERROR.
`ExpiryDate` is YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss in Chisinau local time (Europe/Chisinau) and must be in the future.

Guides, hosted checkout form and notification (webhook) signatures: see llms-full.txt next to this file.

post.description: The delete linked card method is used to deactivate and remove a previously linked card from the Paynet system. When this method is executed, the specified card token is permanently invalidated, and the card is unlinked from the customer account. As a result, the token can no longer be used for any payment operations, including recurring or one-click payments. To perform this request, the Partner must provide the unique card identifier (CardLinkHash), the corresponding SaleAreaCode, and the CustomerCode associated with the card. This method ensures that sensitive payment credentials are securely removed and prevents any further unauthorized or unintended use.

post.description: In order to perform a payment via Paynet API, the payment must first be registered in the Paynet system. The Create order method is used to create (register) a new payment order by transmitting the required payment details from the Partner’s system to Paynet. Upon successful registration, Paynet generates and returns a unique payment identifier (Payment ID). This Payment ID is then used to redirect the customer to the Paynet payment page, where the user can review, confirm, and complete the payment. In this model, direct server-to-server communication between the Partner and Paynet is required. Data signing is not mandatory, as authentication is handled via an authorization token.

get.description: The get payment info method is used to retrieve detailed information about a specific payment using its unique identifier (PaymentId). To perform this request, the Partner must provide the payment ID in the request URL. Paynet will return the current status of the payment along with all relevant details, such as amount, currency, transaction status, and associated metadata. This method allows the Partner to verify the payment status, track transaction progress, and obtain up-to-date information about a previously registered payment.

get.description: The get transaction list method is used to retrieve a list of payments within a specified date and time interval. To perform this request, the Partner must provide the from and to parameters in the query string, defining the start and end of the search period. Paynet will return a collection of transactions that were created or processed within the specified timeframe. Each transaction record includes relevant details such as payment ID, amount, currency, status, and timestamps. This method allows the Partner to perform transaction monitoring, reporting, and reconciliation over a defined period.

post.description: The refund method is used to return funds for a previously completed payment. To perform a refund, the Partner must send the original PaymentId, refund amount, currency, sale area code, refund type, and the reason for the refund. The refund can be processed as either a full refund or a partial refund, depending on the RefundType and the amount provided in the request. After the refund request is processed, Paynet returns the result of the operation, allowing the Partner to confirm whether the refund was successfully registered and executed in the Paynet system.

post.description: To access the Paynet service and complete authorization, you need to obtain an authorization token. You can get this token by calling the service method described below and providing the parameters (username and password) received during partner registration.

password.description: The user's password in plain text.

Code.description: The unique code or identifier for the customer.

Customer.description: Represents the customer details for a payment.

CardLinkHash.description: The unique hash identifying the specific card to be unlinked.

SaleAreaCode.description: The code identifying the specific sale area or merchant environment.

CustomerCode.description: The unique identifier or code of the customer who owns the linked card.

DeleteLinkedCardRequest.description: Represents the payload required to unlink a saved payment card.

status.description: Gets or sets the HTTP status code associated with the error (e.g., 400, 401, 500).

message.description: Gets or sets a human-readable, descriptive error message intended for the client.

code.description: Gets or sets the internal business logic error code or its string representation.

traceId.description: Gets or sets an optional unique identifier used for request tracing and debugging in the logs.

details.description:
Gets or sets optional technical details or additional context regarding the error 
(e.g., specific validation failures).

ErrorModel.description: Represents a standardized error response returned by the API.

Order.description: The unique identifier for the order.

SaleAreaCode.description: The code representing the sale area or merchant location.

LinkUrlSuccess.description: The URL to redirect to upon a successful payment.

LinkUrlCancel.description: The URL to redirect to if the payment is canceled.

CardLinkHash.description: (Optional) Linked-card hash. If CardLinkHash is provided, the full Customer object (Code, NameFirst, NameLast, email, PhoneNumber) becomes required.

ExpiryDate.description: The expiration date and time for this payment request. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss, Chisinau local time (Europe/Chisinau); must be in the future.

Services.description: The list of services included in this payment.

MoneyType.description: Payment methods shown to the customer: "All" — all methods enabled for the merchant; "Card" — card (Visa/Mastercard), Apple Pay, Google Pay; "Paynet" — Paynet wallet; "MIA" — MIA instant payments; "CashInvoice" — cash invoice.

Lang.description: UI language for payment page (example: RO or RU or EN).

PaymentRequest.description: Represents the payload for initiating a payment request. Fields not marked as required are optional.

LineNo.description: The line number or position of the product in the list.

UnitPrice.description: The price per single unit of the product.

Quantity.description: The quantity of the product being purchased.

Amount.description: The total amount for this quantity (usually UnitPrice * Quantity).

TotalAmount.description: The final total amount including any taxes or discounts.

Product.description: Represents a single product item within a service.

PaymentId.description: The unique internal identifier of the original payment transaction to be refunded.

SaleAreaCode.description: The code identifying the specific sale area or point of sale where the original transaction occurred.

Amount.description: The exact amount to be refunded.

Currency.description: The numeric ISO code of the currency for the refund amount.

Reason.description: A descriptive reason or justification for processing the refund.

RefundRequest.description: Represents the payload required to initiate a refund for a specific payment transaction.

Amount.description: The total amount for this service.

Products.description: (Optional) A list of specific products under this service. If at least one Products field is provided, all Product fields become required.

Service.description: Represents a service included in the payment request.

access_token.description: Bearer token for the Authorization header.

PaymentResponse.description: Payment object returned by create/get endpoints.

paymentId.description: Paynet payment ID. Store it with your order.

paymentLink.description: URL of the Paynet payment page. Redirect the customer here.

status.description: Payment status code. A new order has status 1.

signature.description: Internal value of the payment link (equals the s parameter of paymentLink); null in GET responses. Not a signature to verify.

paidAmount.description: Amount actually paid, minor units; null until the payment is paid.

paidDate.description: Set when the payment is paid.

ErrorModelUnauthorized.description: 401 for a missing, invalid or expired Bearer token. Note the capitalised keys.

ErrorInfoResponse.description: 400 when the request body cannot be read (invalid JSON, wrong types, missing required fields).

RefundResponse.description: Refund result (immediate; no notification is sent).

moneyType.description: Processing code, e.g. CYBER_SOURCE (not the notification MoneyType).
